class.name: OcgStlapiReader
class.brief_description: Reading from stereolithography format. Reads STL file and creates a shape composed of triangular faces, one per facet. IMPORTANT: This approach is very inefficient, especially for large files. IMPORTANT: Consider reading STL file to Poly_Triangulation object instead (see class RWStl).

IMPORTANT: This approach is very inefficient, especially for large files. ! IMPORTANT: Consider reading STL file to Poly_Triangulation object instead (see class RWStl).

method.name: Read_1
method.description: Reads STL file to the TopoDS_Shape (each triangle is converted to the face).

method.name: Read_2
method.description: Reads STL data from stream to the TopoDS_Shape (each triangle is converted to the face).
